description_en: Queries the instance RAM roles that are assigned to one or more ECS instances by instance ID, or queries the instances that are assigned a specific instance RAM role by role name
description_zh: 本接口具备两个主要功能，支持依据实例 ID 来查询一台或多台 ECS 实例所被授予的实RAM角色，同时也允许通过实例 RAM 角色名称来查询被授予了该特定角色的实例情况
kebab_example: aliyun ecs describe-instance-ram-role --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-ids 'i-bp67acfmxazb1p0000_,_i-bp67acfmxazb2p0000_,_bp67acfmxazb3p0000_…' --biz-ram-role-name EcsServiceRole-EcsDocGuideTest --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeInstanceRamRole

parameters.description_en:

parameters.description_en:
The instance IDs of the instances to query. You can specify up to 50 instances at a time.
> You must specify at least one of the InstanceIds and RamRoleName parameters.
parameters.description_zh:
指定查询的实例ID的集合。最多支持一次查询50台实例。
> `InstanceIds`与`RamRoleName`参数必须至少填写一个。

parameters.description_en:
The name of the instance RAM role. You can use this parameter to query all ECS instances that are assigned the specified instance RAM role. You can call the RAM API [ListRoles](~~28713~~) to query the instance RAM roles that you created.
> You must specify at least one of InstanceIds and RamRoleName.
